referee_caveats_inferred: Single constant alpha_CO=4.36 and R31=0.5 adopted for all QGs; delta_DGR scales directly with these
Half the sample lacks detections in at least one tracer; limits drive some conclusions
Mdust for sources without IR data depends on SED priors
Only 17 galaxies at z~0.4, so generalisation to high z is uncertain
